content.short: Cobo Argus is an institutional on-chain asset management solution with role-based access controls and DeFi investment strategy automation on Mantle.
content.description: Cobo Argus is an institutional-grade on-chain asset management platform by Cobo, a leading crypto custody provider, enabling organizations to manage DeFi investments with enterprise-level security through role-based access controls, transaction whitelisting, and multi-signature governance. Teams can safely execute DeFi strategies on Mantle while maintaining strict security policies and comprehensive audit trails. Cobo Argus bridges institutional treasury management with DeFi yield opportunities.
